title: Structure, Not Sequence: Tracking and Validating Folding Mechanisms in ESMFold's Trunk with Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.36226v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Structure predictors like ESMFold fold proteins using neural network computation and have transformed structural biology. However, the driving mechanism from amino-acid (AA) sequence to 3D structure is insufficiently understood, and biological meaning remains locked in the dense network. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have shown promising results in obtaining interpretable concept features over an overcomplete basis of intermediate protein sequence-model representations. Yet folding models, which predict physical shape from AA sequence semantics, have no such account. We hypothesize that the features carrying the folding computation evolve in the 3D structural regression process. In this paper, we interpret the folding trunk in three steps. First, a pilot analysis on the representation distribution across modules and recycles locates distinct spatial computation in the trunk. translated_title: 结构而非序列：利用稀疏自编码器追踪并验证 ESMFold 主干中的折叠机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.36226v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：诸如 ESMFold 之类的结构预测器通过神经网络计算来折叠蛋白质，已经彻底改变了结构生物学。然而，从氨基酸（AA）序列到三维结构的驱动机制仍然缺乏充分的理解，其生物学意义依旧被“锁”在稠密网络之中。稀疏自编码器（SAEs）已被证明能够在中间蛋白质序列模型表示的超完备基上获得可解释的概念特征，并展现出可观的前景。然而，对于从氨基酸序列语义预测物理形状的折叠模型，目前尚无这样的可解释性研究。我们假设承载折叠计算的特征会在三维结构回归过程中发生演化。在本文中，我们分三步对折叠主干进行解释。首先，通过对各模块与循环（recycles）间表示分布的初步分析，定位了主干中独特的空间计算方式。其次，学到的字典揭示了一种分工现象：单个
tldr: 该论文首次用稀疏自编码器解析 ESMFold 的折叠主干，发现承载折叠计算的特征按“结构而非序列”组织，并在三维结构回归过程中呈现出模块化的功能分工。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to interpret ESMFold's folding trunk with sparse autoencoders, showing that the features carrying folding computation are organized by structure rather than sequence and exhibit modular division of labor across the 3D structural regression process.
